lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Carhenge — the proposed redevelopment of 700 W. Pacific Avenue gets two separate hearings on September 30: a special HARC session reviewing preliminary architecture for multiple building clusters, and a special Town Council hearing on the lot-subdivision appeal that Sphere Law filed after P&Z's July approval. While that plays out, the Gondola Leadership Committee takes up a consequential choice between federal funding and local project delivery, and county commissioners work-session a proposed Employee Housing Impact Fee that could reshape how San Miguel County funds workforce housing.

notable.stake: Council must weigh federal funding strings against local control for gondola delivery.
